function.name: ListDir
function.description: List directory contents. Directories first, then files, each sorted alphabetically; '/' suffix marks directories, file size shown for files. Permission codes (e.g. 755/644) are shown on Linux only. Ends with a summary of file/dir counts and extension groups. Output is truncated to 500 entries.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default: 500)
